messages:
Alex: rolled kernel-picker v2 to canary overnight; p95 decode on host-proxy for small-reqs is up ~12%. noticing more CPU in parse/tokenization.
Sara: any traces or perf tops yet?
Alex: perf top: tokenizer::scan_chars ~30%, grpc::writev_serialize ~11%, kvcache::evict ~9%. logs show varied token_scan_us per req.
Jamal: recall we also reduced host_preparse_budget_ms 6->3 in the rollout. that could affect streaming coalescing.
Chris: tcpdump + pprof from canary show many small HTTP2 frames (~1-2KB) and repeated tokenizer buffer resizes -> increased writev calls.
infra-bot: alert: canary small_write_pct rose 17%->42% (ingress-metrics).
Irene: kv-hit dropped 0.95->0.86; eviction rate doubled.
Sara: mitigation proposal: rollback preparse_budget to 6 on canary, add tokenizer buffer pooling, and add a kernel-picker guard to avoid switching for seq_len < 64. also test batcher.max_batch_size 4 vs 8.
Alex: agreed. I'll patch canary for budget rollback and monitor. Jamal/Chris to run bench matrix and attach artifacts.
perf-bot: queued perf job: smallreq-mix (v1,v2) id=9610.
